Now write SQL. Denominator: carcinogenic molecules (label='+') count. Numerator: carcinogenic molecules with no fluorine atom.

Per L2 qid4: "does not contain fluorine" means no atom of that element is present. Per qid5: percentages count same entities on both sides (molecules).

SQL:

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.molecule_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element='f') f ON m.molecule_id = f.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';
